summary: Shows a grey pulsing block as a loading placeholder.
purpose: Shows where content will appear while it loads.
why: Likely reason: a standard loading pattern that avoids blank space.
how: Draws a rounded block with a pulse animation and a light background. Extra class names and attributes from the parent are added on top.
inputs: Size and style through class names, plus standard attributes.
risks: It does nothing to end loading. The parent must remove it when the content arrives.
debug: If it never goes away, check the parent's loading condition.
